mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate relative to its 12-month moving average compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic conditions.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS is below its 12-month moving average (t-test p > 0.05 over 5-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.3 percentage points over three months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE increases by more than 0.3pp in three months (t-test p > 0.05 over 5-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and real personal consumption expenditures exceeding 1% in the same month indicate broad-based consumer demand contraction, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are not significantly negative when both HOUST and RSAFS decline by more than 1% in the same month (t-test p > 0.05 over 5-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: Negative industrial production growth signals manufacturing slowdowns and supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days during supply-constrained regimes.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO growth is negative (t-test p > 0.05 over 5-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: Positive nonfarm payrolls growth indicates strengthening labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days regardless of economic conditions.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are not significantly positive when PAYEMS growth is positive (t-test p > 0.05 over 5-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 2.5% signals potential monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5% (t-test p > 0.05 over 5-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: Slowing GDP growth below 2% annualized combined with CPI inflation exceeding 2.5% indicates stagflationary pressures, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are not significantly negative when GDPC1 growth is below 2% and CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5% (t-test p > 0.05 over 5-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: A tight labor market (UNRATE < 4%) combined with unchanged federal funds rate signals persistent wage pressures without monetary easing, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
regime_hint: tight labor market with no rate cuts
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE < 4% and FEDFUNDS is unchanged (t-test p > 0.05 over 5-year rolling windows).
